title: Polarization preserves output probabilities
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $b\\in\\{-1,1\\}$. The uniform probability that the coordinate polarization of $f$ at $i$ equals $b$ is the same as the uniform probability that $f$ equals $b$.
